sentences.en: Hello, everybody, and welcome back to The Psychology of Your Twenties, the podcast where we talk through some of the big life changes and transitions of our 20s
sentences.zh: 大家好，欢迎回到《你的二十岁心理学》，在这里我们探讨二十岁时的一些重大生活改变和转折，

sentences.en: and what they mean for our psychology.
sentences.zh: 以及它们对我们心理意味着什么。

sentences.en: Hello, everybody.
sentences.zh: 大家好。

sentences.en: Welcome back to the show.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回到节目中。

sentences.en: Welcome back to the podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回到本播客。

sentences.en: New listeners, old listeners, wherever you are in the world, it is so great to have you here back for another episode as we dive into the psychology of our 20s.
sentences.zh: 新听众、老听众，无论你身处世界的哪个角落，很高兴你能回来收听又一期节目，和我们一起深入探讨二十岁的心理学。

sentences.en: This episode today, we are going to get quite vulnerable.
sentences.zh: 今天的这期节目，我们要剖析一些相当脆弱的内心。

sentences.en: If you are a frequent listener of the show, you will know that I'm always looking for episode suggestions, things that you guys, my fellow 20-something-year-olds, are going through
sentences.zh: 如果你经常收听这个节目，你就会知道我一直在寻找节目选题，寻找你们这些和我一样二十多岁的年轻人正在经历的事情，

sentences.en: as inspiration for the podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 以此作为播客的灵感。

sentences.en: Someone sent in this suggestion.
sentences.zh: 有人发来了这个建议。

sentences.en: Actually, multiple of you sent in this suggestion, and I read some of these messages and just thought, how have we never discussed this before?
sentences.zh: 其实不止一个人发来了这个建议，当我读到其中一些留言时，就觉得，我们怎么从来没讨论过这个话题？

sentences.en: What we're talking about today is a fear of intimacy.
sentences.zh: 我们今天要聊的是对亲密关系的恐惧。

sentences.en: So many of you have been waiting for this episode, and there is just a wealth of research, content, articles, theories that go along with it.
sentences.zh: 你们当中有很多人一直在期待这期节目，与之相关的研究、内容、文章和理论可以说是极其丰富。

sentences.en: And I also think it's something that so many of us in our 20s struggle with in silence and might not even realize that we are going through.
sentences.zh: 而且我也认为，这是我们许多二十多岁的人在默默挣扎却甚至可能没有意识到自己正在经历的事情。

sentences.en: I think a fear of intimacy is so valuable to understand because it's also one of those ideas that has become misconstrued, misunderstood, overused in recent years.
sentences.zh: 我认为理解对亲密关系的恐惧非常有价值，因为这也是近年来被曲解、被误解、被过度使用的概念之一。

sentences.en: And with that overuse, sometimes we don't always know the facts.
sentences.zh: 随着这种过度使用，有时我们并不总能了解事实真相。

sentences.en: And of course, the science and the psychology behind why it occurs, how it presents in our lives, and also ways to move forward, potential solutions.
sentences.zh: 当然，还有它为什么会产生、它如何在我们的生活中表现出来的科学与心理学原理，以及前进的方法和潜在的解决方案。

sentences.en: It's one of those classic catch-22 problems in psychology.
sentences.zh: 这是心理学中典型的两难问题之一。

sentences.en: We want more people to have a label for what they're experiencing, but that label still needs to be an informed one.
sentences.zh: 我们希望更多人能为自己的经历贴上一个标签，但这个标签仍然需要是一个基于充分了解的标签。

sentences.en: And we want people to have the correct information about what they're describing.
sentences.zh: 我们希望人们对他们所描述的事物有正确的了解。

sentences.en: So that's what we're going to talk about today because I think so many of us struggle with a fear of intimacy in our 20s.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是我们今天要讨论的内容，因为我认为我们当中有很多人在二十多岁时都在与亲密恐惧作斗争。

sentences.en: And I don't always think we have the right information.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为我们并不总能获得正确的信息。

sentences.en: A fear of intimacy during this decade shows up in a lot of different, often invisible ways.
sentences.zh: 在这十年里，对亲密关系的恐惧以许多不同的、通常隐蔽的方式表现出来。

sentences.en: Maybe you have found yourself in like a constant cycle of situationships.
sentences.zh: 也许你发现自己陷入了某种暧昧不清关系的死循环中。

sentences.en: You push people away when they're trying to get to know you, both friends and people you're dating.
sentences.zh: 当别人试图了解你时，你把他们推开，无论是朋友还是约会对象。

sentences.en: You can never bring yourself to go on first dates.
sentences.zh: 你总是无法说服自己去约会。

sentences.en: You start fights when things begin to feel safe.
sentences.zh: 当事情开始变得有安全感时，你反而挑起争端。

sentences.en: You may have placed all of these conditions on yourself for when you'll be allowed to date.
sentences.zh: 你可能为自己设定了各种各样的条件，觉得只有达到这些条件才被允许去约会。

sentences.en: You know, I can't date until I've lost weight, until I fix something about myself, until I love myself more.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，比如我瘦下来之前不能约会，我得先改掉身上的某个毛病，我得先更爱自己才行。

sentences.en: All of these actions and habits is a fear of vulnerability.
sentences.zh: 所有这些行为和习惯的背后，其实是对展现脆弱的恐惧。

sentences.en: And it is secretly keeping us from being vulnerable,
sentences.zh: 它暗中阻碍我们去展现脆弱，

sentences.en: intimate with people around us because we are scared that when we get too close we get hurt or that perhaps we aren't worthy of the love we think we deserve so we shy away
sentences.zh: 无法与周围的人亲密相处，因为我们害怕一旦靠得太近就会受到伤害，或者也许我们觉得自己不配得到自认为应得的爱，所以我们对任何能证明自己是错的机会

sentences.en: from any opportunity for us to be proven wrong.
sentences.zh: 都退避三舍。

sentences.en: I think to be emotionally intimate with someone is to essentially give ourselves and give other people the guidebook on how exactly to hurt us.
sentences.zh: 我认为，与某人建立情感上的亲密，本质上就是把自己和他人的一本指导手册交出去，上面写明了究竟该如何伤害我们。

sentences.en: If you have been left, you know, scarred or burned by a past relationship, attachment problems in childhood, even if you're just feeling particularly insecure,
sentences.zh: 如果你曾被过去的感情留下伤痕或灼伤，有过童年依恋问题，或者哪怕你只是感到特别缺乏安全感，

sentences.en: I think that love can be one of the hardest things that we can put ourselves through because there is so much opportunity for disaster, so much opportunity to be hurt,
sentences.zh: 我认为爱可能是我们所能经历的最艰难的事情之一，因为它有太多导致灾难的可能，有太多受伤的可能，

sentences.en: so much so that we avoid that crucial source, that being love and meaningful connection.
sentences.zh: 以至于我们甚至开始逃避那个至关重要的源泉，也就是爱与有意义的连接。

sentences.en: It's actually quite devastating really.
sentences.zh: 说实话，这其实相当令人痛心。

sentences.en: I think a lot of us know this is going on behind the scenes.
sentences.zh: 我想我们很多人都知道幕后正在发生这一切。

sentences.en: We are not blind to how this pattern of behavior and fear is active in our lives.
sentences.zh: 我们并非没有察觉到这种行为模式和恐惧在我们的生活中是如何活跃的。

sentences.en: We want to be open.
sentences.zh: 我们渴望敞开心扉。

sentences.en: We want a witness to our lives.
sentences.zh: 我们希望有人见证我们的生活。

sentences.en: We want to be seen.
sentences.zh: 我们渴望被看见。

sentences.en: But it also comes with the realization that allowing ourselves to go through this might actually do something to hurt us further.
sentences.zh: 但这也伴随着一种意识到，即允许自己经历这一切实际上可能会带来进一步伤害我们的结果。

sentences.en: Sometimes that fear is too strong to push paSt.
sentences.zh: 有时候这种恐惧太强烈，让人无法跨越。

sentences.en: So my hope is that this episode is of some help to you because I don't think big problems like this are overcome in a day but the first step is actually being able to diagnose
sentences.zh: 所以我希望这期节目能对你有所帮助，因为我认为像这样的大问题无法在一天内解决，但第一步其实是能够诊断

sentences.en: and understand the problem and having enough background information to proceed.
sentences.zh: 并理解这个问题，并掌握足够的背景信息以继续前行。

sentences.en: So without further ado, let's get into it.
sentences.zh: 那么闲话少说，我们直接切入正题。

sentences.en: So fear of intimacy is known by a few other names, the most common one being avoidance anxiety which is sometimes applied to a lot more than just love.
sentences.zh: 对亲密关系的恐惧还有其他几个名字，最常见的一个是回避型焦虑，有时它适用的范围远不止爱情。

sentences.en: Avoidance anxiety really gets to the heart of how a fear of intimacy is sustained.
sentences.zh: 回避型焦虑真正触及了亲密恐惧得以维持的核心。

sentences.en: When we have an excessive fear, concern, worry towards a particular object or subject, the easiest way to actually regulate that anxious response is to kind of avoid
sentences.zh: 当我们对某个特定的对象或主题产生过度的恐惧、担忧、忧虑时，实际调节这种焦虑反应最简单的方法就是去回避

sentences.en: anything that triggers it.
sentences.zh: 任何会触发它的事物。

sentences.en: So in that way, avoidance becomes a coping mechanism whereby we are so paralyzed by what would happen if we encountered our fear that we act in the most rational way we can
sentences.zh: 通过这种方式，回避变成了一种应对机制，使我们因遇到恐惧时会发生什么而感到如此瘫痪，以至于我们采取了力所能及的最理性的方式，

sentences.en: which is just to avoid that from ever happening.
sentences.zh: 那就是直接避免这种情况发生。

sentences.en: In the case of a fear of intimacy, the trigger is not an object though.
sentences.zh: 然而，在对亲密关系感到恐惧的情况下，触发因素并不是一个具体的物体。

sentences.en: It's not some fear like snakes or spiders or planes.
sentences.zh: 它不是对蛇、蜘蛛或飞机那样的恐惧。

sentences.en: It's the feeling or a situation that being in an intimate social contact with someone else might jeopardize our sense of security and safety that we have created for ourselves
sentences.zh: 而是一种感觉或情境，即与他人保持亲密的社交接触可能会危及我们在内心为自己构建的安全感

sentences.en: internally.
sentences.zh: 和保障。

sentences.en: Now a fear of intimacy is actually quite multifaceted.
sentences.zh: 实际上，对亲密关系的恐惧是多方面的。

sentences.en: It can be emotional, sexual, even intellectual or spiritual.
sentences.zh: 它可以是情感上的、性方面的，甚至是智力或精神上的。

sentences.en: So if we fear emotional intimacy, what we're fearing is sharing our innermost feelings and true emotions with someone and perhaps scaring them off.
sentences.zh: 如果我们害怕情感亲密，我们害怕的是与某人分享内心深处的感觉和真实情绪，并可能把对方吓跑。

sentences.en: Maybe because we are not accustomed to our feelings being important or respected or we're scared of what they will be able to do to us with that information.
sentences.zh: 也许是因为我们不习惯自己的感受受到重视或尊重，或者我们害怕对方会利用这些信息来对付我们。

sentences.en: A fear of sexual intimacy is also known as genophobia is where we have this very serious anxiety about sharing that part of ourselves with someone else.
sentences.zh: 对性亲密的恐惧也被称为性恐惧症，也就是我们对与他人分享这部分自我有着非常严重的焦虑。

sentences.en: Maybe we are worried about being hurt.
sentences.zh: 也许我们担心受到伤害。

sentences.en: We are reflecting on really hard and traumatic past experiences where we weren't given the respect that we deserve and so now we see any time that we're having sex
sentences.zh: 我们在反思那些极其艰难和痛苦的过去经历，当时我们没有得到应有的尊重，所以现在我们把每一次发生性行为

sentences.en: or any opportunity to be intimate with someone as possibly creating the same outcome and that's an outcome that we want to avoid.
sentences.zh: 或与某人亲密接触的机会都视为可能导致相同结果的事情，而这是我们极力想避免的结果。

sentences.en: We also have that fear of intellectual intimacy and that's not a facet of this that I think a lot of us typically think of.
sentences.zh: 我们还有对智力亲密的恐惧，我认为这并不是很多人通常会想到的一个方面。

sentences.en: Intellectual intimacy is this exchange of big ideas and thoughts and core beliefs.
sentences.zh: 智力亲密是宏大想法、思想和核心信念的交流。

sentences.en: That is actually such a vulnerable squishy deep down part of ourselves that very few people I think ever really get access to in our lives and there's a lot that they can do
sentences.zh: 这其实是我们内心深处非常脆弱、柔软且隐秘的部分，我认为在我们的生活中很少有人真正能够触及，他们可能会利用

sentences.en: with that information we might worry that someone will be dismissive or use these things against us and we might worry that they won't agree with us they'll embarrass us
sentences.zh: 这些信息做很多事情，我们可能会担心别人会轻视或者利用这些事情来对付我们，我们可能会担心他们不同意我们的观点、让我们难堪，

sentences.en: that we'll realize that we're actually not as connected as we thought.
sentences.zh: 我们会发现其实彼此并没有想象中那么契合。

sentences.en: The root of all these fears is very subjective whether you have a fear of emotional intimacy intellectual intimacy sexual intimacy it's based primarily on past experiences
sentences.zh: 所有这些恐惧的根源都是非常主观的，无论你害怕的是情感亲密、智力亲密还是性亲密，它主要都基于过去的经历

sentences.en: and a history with a whole bunch of things that can influence our approach to being loved and accepting love.
sentences.zh: 以及一系列能够影响我们如何对待爱和接受爱的事物历史。

sentences.en: When we have this fear of intimacy it prevents us from engaging in behaviors that will create a lifelong or sustaining bond.
sentences.zh: 当我们对亲密关系产生这种恐惧时，它会阻止我们做出能够建立终身或持久纽带的行为。

sentences.en: Unfortunately for us you know to be loved is to be intellectually intimate is to be emotionally intimate is to sometimes be sexually intimate and sadly a relationship
sentences.zh: 对我们来说不幸的是，要被爱，就需要进行智力上的亲密、情感上的亲密，有时还需要性方面的亲密，可悲的是，一段关系

sentences.en: does have some core parameters and necessary foundations and we will have to kind of get past this fear of sharing those deep parts of ourselves if we ever want to truly feel
sentences.zh: 确实有一些核心参数和必要的基础，如果我们真的想感受到

sentences.en: like we should accept or feel like we can accept love into our lives.
sentences.zh: 自己应该接受爱，或者觉得自己能够接受爱进入我们的生活，我们就必须跨越这种分享内心深处自我的恐惧。

sentences.en: We mentioned some of the indicators of a fear of intimacy briefly before but to dive into it a little bit further some of the signs that you might be struggling with this
sentences.zh: 我们之前简要提到过一些亲密恐惧的迹象，但为了更深入地探讨，其中一些可能表明你正在为此苦恼的迹象，

sentences.en: whether consciously or not includes a series of really short relationships that all end because of insignificant things they gave you a small ick they didn't finish all their food
sentences.zh: 无论你是否意识到，包括了一系列非常短暂的恋情，它们最终都因为微不足道的小事而告终：比如他们在约会时有一个小举动让你下头、他们没有吃完盘子里的所有食物、

sentences.en: on a date they didn't like the same music as you these icks these reasons that you think are valid may actually be protecting you from a deep explanation a deeper explanation
